item.title: Trump Headlines Texas Convention to Tap Donors, Rally Voters
item.description:
The two-day midterm political convention in Dallas this week is Republicans’ last, best chance to put on a show and appeal to donors and corporations ahead of a November election that’s increasingly favoring Democrats. President Trump floated the idea of the convention a year ago as a way to rally voters and ensure Republican control of Congress. But it may be too late for that, given his flagging popularity and a second-term agenda that has failed to address voters’ economic concerns. For more, we speak with Julie Fine, Bloomberg News Texas Bureau Chief. (Source: Bloomberg)
